instruction:
Two-software CAE flow: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. No init file is provided; start from a new blank SolidWorks part.

Chain evidence requirement: use the design token EW_SW_ABQ_03. Keep this token encoded in the SolidWorks part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage1_geometry.step contains EW_SW_ABQ_03 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_SW_ABQ_03 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.

1. In SolidWorks, use sketch and feature tools to create a D120 x 10 mm circular flange cover with a centered D60 recessed pressure face, eight D6 bolt holes on a 90 mm bolt circle, and a small outer chamfer. Export the completed CAD geometry to C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. In Abaqus/CAE, import stage1_geometry.step and create the finite-element model. Use the model name Model-FlangePressure. Define material Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, create a solid section using Steel, and assign it to the flange cover. Create a Static General analysis step named Step-Pressure. Create a set named BOLT_HOLES and a surface named PRESSURE_FACE. Use a coarse first-order linear solid mesh that captures the bolt holes and recessed pressure face without dense bolt-hole refinement; use C3D8R where practical or coarse C3D4 where needed, and do not use quadratic elements. Create a boundary condition named BC-BoltHoles that constrains BOLT_HOLES. Create a pressure load named Pressure-1p5MPa with magnitude approximately 1.5 MPa on PRESSURE_FACE. Submit the job named Job-FlangePressure and wait for the analysis to complete.
3. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-FlangePressure.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-FlangePressure.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

 First use SolidWorks to create and export the CAD STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables.
